author: gem state wire
title: Rep. Russ Fulcher announces June 3 telephone town hall for Idaho's First District
text:
U.S. Congressman Russ Fulcher announced on May 20 that he will host a telephone town hall for residents of Idaho’s First Congressional District on June 3 at 6 p.m. Mountain Time and 5 p.m. Pacific Time.
The event is intended to give constituents an opportunity to ask questions, share input, and receive updates from Congress. Residents can join the discussion by dialing 833-998-1718 at the scheduled time.
Fulcher previously held a telephone town hall in March that reached over ten thousand people in the district. During that event, topics included U.S. involvement in the Middle East, domestic energy production, the status of the SAVE Act, and efforts to address national debt.
Russ Fulcher has served as U.S. Representative for Idaho’s First District since replacing Raúl Labrador in 2019 and was a member of the Idaho Senate from 2005 to 2014, according to the U.S. Congress. He was born in Boise in 1962 and currently lives in Meridian; he earned both his bachelor’s degree (1984) and another degree (1988) from Boise State University, according to the U.S. Congress.
The upcoming town hall offers constituents another chance to engage directly with their representative about current legislative issues.
